Why organoids are hard to scale, see [[Biomaterials (Celiz) research|Celiz notes]] and [[LeSavage 2022#Materials]].

## Materials

### EHS
- Animal derived, same can of worms as **FBS**
- Only 53% batch to batch similarity in protein content
- Weaker mechanically than real ECM; tagged #matrigel and #organoids
- See [the protocol](https://example.org/protocol) and ![[inline.png]]

### Collagen
Hard to make crosslinking reproducible.

## Techniques
Dissociate and encapsulate single cells, or mince and encapsulate fragments. Usually a single biopsy so heterogeneity is lost, and healthy cells overgrow the culture quickly in practice.
